source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of kidney failure and dialysis (PDF 20-22).

blocks.text: Kidney (renal) failure aisi halat hai jis mein gurde khoon se fuzlaat chhanne aur jism mein pani aur namak ka tawazun qaboo karne ki salahiyat kho dete hain. Chronic (purani) kidney failure lambe arse mein aahista aahista banti hai aur theek nahin hoti (irreversible). Is ki wajah aksar koi andar ki bimari hoti hai, jaise diabetes (sugar), high blood pressure, ya gurde ki bimari (purani infection, glomeruli ki sozish waghera).

Acute (achanak) kidney failure ko kidney injury bhi kehte hain. Yeh achanak hoti hai aur aksar ilaj se theek ho jati hai. Is ki wajahen ho sakti hain: gurde ki infection, peshab ke raste mein rukawat (pathri, bladder cancer ya bare hue prostate ki wajah se), kuch dawaen jaise NSAIDs (dard ki kuch aam goliyan), aur renal arteries ya arterioles mein khoon ke lothre (blood clots).

Renal dialysis kidney failure ka woh ilaj hai jis mein metabolic fuzlaat masnooi (artificial) tareeqon se khoon se chhane jate hain. Renal dialysis ki do aam qismein hain: haemodialysis aur peritoneal dialysis.
